verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports say RustDesk detected two remote screens and let the user click 1 or 2 to choose which one to show, which covers monitor selection and implies switching during a session. There is no first-party documentation of multi-monitor handling and no evidence of viewing a single window or app. Missing for 10: per-window/per-app viewing, first-party docs on monitor selection and mid-session switching, and corroboration beyond one anecdotal report.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session
